market.question: Will the highest temperature in Lucknow be 35°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Lucknow early May average highs ~38-39C (102F); May 3 forecast falls in this range. The 35C bucket sits well below the typical high, so probability of the high being only 35C is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of a thunderstorm/cloud-cover day depressing the high.
